title: Nameless Country Ramble
summary: A short country ride from Leander to Liberty Hill that I like for its light traffic, good pavement, and relaxed pace.
body_markdown:
I like this route when I want an easy ride through the country. The roads aren’t too busy, the pavement is good, and I enjoy it without going particularly fast.

It’s about 18 miles from Leander to Liberty Hill, following Hero Way, Nameless Road, and Round Mountain Road before finishing on TX-29.

sources.title: Google Maps route supplied by the rider

author_note.text: What I like most is the quieter roads and the country setting. Good pavement and a relaxed pace make this a personal favorite.

waypoints: Nameless Road at Round Mountain Road
via: Hero Way W -> Old FM 2243 -> Nameless Rd -> Round Mountain Rd -> CR 282 -> RM 1869 -> TX-29
